input.script:
local companies = tool('list_companies')
local domain_to_company = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then domain_to_company[c.domain] = c.name end
end

-- Gather all contacts
local all_contacts = {}
local page = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do all_contacts[#all_contacts + 1] = ct end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

local phones_fixed = 0
local companies_filled = 0
local details = {}

for _, ct in ipairs(all_contacts) do
  local upd = { id = ct.id }
  local need = false

  -- Phone check: E.164 US = +1 followed by exactly 10 digits
  local ph = ct.phone or ""
  if not ph:match("^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$") then
    local digits = ph:gsub("%D", "")
    local newph
    if #digits == 10 then
      newph = "+1" .. digits
    elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == "1" then
      newph = "+" .. digits
    end
    if newph and newph ~= ph then
      upd.phone = newph
      need = true
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end
  end

  -- Company check
  local comp = ct.company or ""
  if comp == "" then
    local email = ct.email or ""
    local domain = email:match("@(.+)$")
    if domain and domain_to_company[domain] then
      upd.company = domain_to_company[domain]
      need = true
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
  end

  if need then
    tool('update_contact', upd)
    details[#details + 1] = { id = ct.id, name = ct.name, phone = upd.phone, company = upd.company }
  end
end

return { total = #all_contacts, phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, details = details, companies = companies }
